project.name: Esbiko
project.purpose: Virtual science laboratory and educational simulation platform

separationOfResponsibilities.esbiko: Owns platform architecture, simulations, APIs, catalogs, documentation and product roadmap.
separationOfResponsibilities.keynu: External runtime and execution bridge only. Keynu must not become the canonical store for Esbiko architecture or product documentation.

mandatoryRules: Read Esbiko documentation before changing architecture.
Simulations are not standalone application pages.
Do not add simulation-specific imports or routes to src/App.jsx.
Register simulations through the canonical experiments catalog and platform runtime.
Generated catalog files must be generated from source, not treated as the primary source.
Do not modify unrelated files while adding a simulation.
Run verification and read back modified files before committing.
